description: napi's live view: attached, the actor is reported stopped once, on entry, and is never paused; a send from the console runs a macrostep whose <log> and summary are output and after which an invalidated event refreshes the stack and the variables; a function breakpoint is a tracepoint that says where it would have stopped; continue changes nothing and reports the entry stop again
why: the test host's adapter stops its workbench's actors, on a developer's machine; napi's never stops a live actor (napi ADR 0026)
